feed.title: Newport Beach Police Department to expand drone program
feed.summary: The Newport Beach City Council approved the expansion of the police department's drone program using Skydio technology, a move expected to cost several million dollars over six years. feed.title: Empery Digital Inc. SEC Filing (Sep 25, 2026)
feed.summary: ATG Capital announced that Institutional Shareholder Services Inc. (ISS) has recommended that Empery Digital Inc. stockholders vote for two of ATG Capital's nominees, Gabriel D. Gliksberg and Aaron T. Morris, to the Empery Digital Board of Directors. ISS also advised withholding support from incumbent directors Orn Olason and Ian Read and voting against the company's equity incentive plan at the upcoming October 14, 2026, Annual Meeting. ATG Capital, the largest non-affiliated stockholder with over 16% of shares, urges stockholders to vote for all four of its independent nominees, citing ISS's findings that the board's functioning has been "less than robust" and its rejection of ATG Capital's nominees was "unjustified."

feed.title: American Airlines Says Downgraded Business Class Passengers on International Flights Aren't Entitled to a Partial Refund: A Couple Want the DOT to Force it to Change
feed.summary: A Tennessee couple, downgraded from Business Class to Premium Economy on an American Airlines international flight, is pursuing legal action and petitioning the DOT to mandate partial cash refunds for downgraded passengers. American Airlines argues it's not obligated to provide compensation under the Montreal Convention, despite a court already siding with the couple once. The Taylors are seeking not only their own compensation but also retroactive payouts for all similarly affected passengers since 2024.
